## About

Yum News publishes practical, step-by-step guides for Android, Gemini AI, Firebase, Claude, Google Home, and developer tooling. Coverage focuses on useful product workflows — from consumer Android features to SDK-level APIs and AI integrations. Articles are written for developers, makers, and technically curious readers.

## Articles (newest first)

### 2026-09-20

- How to Use SwiftKey AI Voice Typing on Any Android Phone
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/swiftkey-ai-voice-android/
  SwiftKey beta 9.13.16.4 adds an offline AI voice mode that cleans filler words like Pixel 11 Rambler. Install the beta, download the on-device model, and dictate in any app.

- How to Lock Quick Settings on Android Canary 2609
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/android-canary-2609-quick-settings-lock/
  Android Canary 2609 (ZP11.260821.010) adds Require unlock for Quick Settings. Which radio tiles lock, how to enable the switch, which Pixels get the build, and why Canary is not a daily driver.

- How to Build On-Device Android AI Agents with ADK for Kotlin 1.0
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/adk-kotlin-1-on-device-android-agents/
  ADK for Kotlin 1.0 is GA. Add Gradle modules, generate @Tool schemas with KSP, and choose LiteRT-LM, Gemini Nano, or Firebase AI Logic.

- How to Use the Updated Google Keep Note Collection Widget on Android
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/google-keep-note-collection-widget/
  Keep 5.26.365 replaces the Note collection sidebar with a circular FAB. Add the widget, filter by label, and capture notes from the home screen.

- How to Use Android Studio Quail 4: Bundled Skills, Parallel Agents, and Layout Inspector
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/android-studio-quail-4-agent-mode/
  Quail 4 (2026.1.4) is the last Quail stable. Use 23 bundled Android skills, parallel-chat status badges, Summary of Changes, Firebase Agent Mode, and recomposition state reads.

- MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro: What the 2nm Flagship Means for Android Phones
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/mediatek-dimensity-9600-pro-2nm-android/
  MediaTek announced the 2nm Dimensity 9600 Pro on 15 September 2026. Dual NPU 1090, LPDDR6, UFS 5.0, and All Big Core C2 CPUs — what buyers and Android developers should check on a spec sheet.

- How to Use Gmail Live to Search Your Inbox by Voice
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/gmail-live-voice-inbox-search/
  Start Gmail Live on Android or iPhone, ask about flights and school mail, open source emails, mute without ending the session. Official Gmail Help and Workspace blog.

- How to Build AI Mini-Apps with Google Labs Opal (No Code)
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/google-labs-opal-mini-apps/
  Create reusable AI mini-apps in Opal: remix the Gallery, describe a workflow in natural language, edit nodes, and publish a share link. Official Google Labs docs and quickstart.

- How to Install One UI 9 on Galaxy S26 and Use the New Galaxy AI Tools
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/samsung-one-ui-9-galaxy-s26-rollout/
  Samsung started the stable One UI 9 rollout on 16 September 2026 for Galaxy S26, S26+, and S26 Ultra. Check for the Android 17 update, then set up My FanCam, Now Nudge, Now Brief, Interpreter, and Security Brief.

- How to Refresh the Pixel Weather Widget After the September 2026 Update
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/pixel-weather-widget-refresh/
  Update Pixel Weather to 1.1.20260716, add the large home-screen widget, and tap the new top-right refresh control. Swipe hourly and 10-day rows in the app.

- How to Transfer Google Authenticator Codes to a New Phone
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/google-authenticator-transfer-new-phone/
  Sync Authenticator with a Google Account or export QR codes from the old phone and import them on the new Android or iPhone before you factory-reset.

- How to Use the Battery-Efficient Google Home Favorites Widget
  https://news.yumpdf.com/blog/google-home-widget-battery/
  Add the Favorites widget on Android 12+ or iOS 17+, choose tiles, and use the 16 September 2026 Home update that pauses widget polling when the screen is off.

- How to Turn Off Smart TV ACR and Viewing Data Collection

  Disable Automatic Content Recognition on Samsung, LG, Sony, Vizio, Hisense, and Roku TVs. Find Viewing Information Services, Live Plus, and Viewing Data toggles.
